item.title: All Day Yo-Yo
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: The all day is a riff on a typical wooden imperial yoyo with a slightly retooled profile and shape. Intended to be carried as a pocket throw and used all day it’s colorway also reflects it with the colors from all day seen on the yoyo.

item.title: Serving Hands
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: Whoever said food isn’t to be played with hasn’t met Serving Friends. These wooden spoons, carved into charming shapes, bring joy and humor to your dining table. No matter what you’re serving, they’ll always be there to serve up smiles.

item.title: Koa ring
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: Taking inspiration from this universal symbol, we’ve created this beautiful ring as a reminder of the earth as a part of the wider universe. Crafted from Hawaii’s native Koa wood, this is a stunning minimalist take on natural jewelry.

item.title: Sandblasted Grapewood plant pot
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: Own a piece of California Wine History! Most of this grapewood comes from Napa and Lodi. Perfect for your airplant or terrarium.

item.title: Linnea Bookshelf
item.author: Giltsoff
item.description:
The Linnea Bookshelf is a lightweight, elegant shelving system which takes inspiration from traditional joinery. With clever joints and compression fittings, the bookshelf is strong without the need for unsightly nuts and bolts.

Each shelf measures W-457mm, H-350mm, D-350mm, so there’s plenty storage room for files, books, and general studio clutter. The open shelving and slim profile of Linnea make it perfect for displaying treasured ornaments, awards, and pictures. Each horizontal shelf extends slightly beyond the vertical supports, providing a small perch onto which lights or even plants can be hung.

Linnea is large with ample storage room but is deceptively lightweight. Made from 12mm thick high-quality Birch Plywood, the Bookshelf can be assembled and moved with ease.

item.title: Wooden Earrings
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: These flat, wood, stud earrings are handmade from beautiful Bubinga hardwood. They are strongly affixed to hypoallergenic titanium posts (nickel-free and lead-free).

item.title: Custom Turntable
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: Custom turntables are available in almost any imaginable form, with parts kits from basic audiophile quality up to the very finest parts available.

item.title: Barbecue Toy Set
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description: Fire up the imagination while firing up this pretend play BBQ with all the “fixins” for a fantastic feast! The 20-piece wooden food set includes grilling favorites like hotdog, hamburger, chicken, steak, ribs, veggie burger, and corn, plus tasty toppings and sturdy utensils. Flip the sturdy corrugated box over and it becomes the “grill,” with pictures of knobs for adjusting the temperature and four self-stick tabs to hold the food. The Wooden Grill & Serve BBQ Set promotes hand-eye coordination, creative expression, and imaginative play.

item.title: Coasters
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description:
These wood coasters are made from reclaimed wood and lacquered for durability. These would be great at place settings or for decoration around the house.

Each coaster measures approximately 4 inches square and are about 3/8 of an inch thick.

item.title: Candle Holders
item.author: Tylee Marsh
item.description:
3 tea light candle holders. They are 2 inches tall and around 2-3 inches in diameter.

Handmade from reclaimed wood, they would make great wedding centerpieces, gifts or just to pretty up your table or shelf.

Tea lights are included.

item.title: Classic Coffeemaker
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Known as a pristine coffeemaker, Chemex employs all of the chemically correct methods for brewing. Its hourglass shaped flask is made entirely of glass, a chemically inert material that does not absorb odors or chemical residues. Includes a polished rubberwood collar with leather tie.

item.title: Cherry Graph Memo Book
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Cherry Graph memo book by Field Notes features real cherry wood covers, filled with 48 pages of tried-and-true Finch Opaque Smooth 50#T with 48 pages of 3/16" graph paper inside.

item.title: Blocks & Marbles
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Look forward to hours of creative maze-building. Handmade by Amish craftsmen in the heart of Indiana, each piece is meticulously inspected for quality. Wooden marble slides add an additional twist to tower construction. These are toys that will be handed down for generations. This set includes 45 hardwood blocks, 14 marbles and a sturdy canvas storage bag.

item.title: Tie Bar
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Add a distinguished finishing touch to any look with these real wood tie bars. Each wood tie clip features a stainless steel body and real wood face that is hand selected for unique grain and quality. Also available in mahogany and walnut.

item.title: Planter
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Each planter is carved from solid maple, lined with durable aluminum, and finished with a cork base. To feature the warmth of the wood, each planter is hand sanded then finished with a vegetable-based oil for a rich, lustrous finish. Perfect for all types of miniature flora. Also available in Walnut.

item.title: Raven II Speakers
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description:
The Raven II speakers deliver stunning sound while fitting into the space you have designed to comfortably live in. They fit horizontally on most bookshelves or rest on our custom Speaker Stands.

Designed to deliver something well suited to modern life, the Raven IIs raise the bar in sound quality. The Raven IIs can be driven by low powered tube amplifiers as well as high output solid state. They perform superbly with our integrated solid state Amp No. 2 and all of the LTA amps (my favorite being the Z40i or the Ultralinear Integrated).

The Raven IIs are a single-driver, sealed-box speaker with solid wood cabinets available in ash or walnut.

item.title: Belmont Sunglasses
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Limited edition Auburn wood frame is inspired by the iconic mascot of wildfire prevention. Crafted from premium-grade dark walnut, each pair features laser-engraved temples and the “Only You” tagline engraved on the polarized lenses. In partnership with the U.S. Forest Service, a portion of every sale goes towards wildfire prevention.

item.title: The Spark Axe
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: With its distinctive lug, sweeping heel, and refined bit The Spark weighs in at just over 2 pounds and measures 17-inches. It’s nimble, accurate, and well-balanced, making it ideal for campfires, kindling, wood carving, and precision hand-work. The rounded poll is designed for game, and processing pelts, and bones, adding another layer of versatility.

item.title: Classic Wooden Blocks
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: This set of 28 classic ABC blocks fits inside a sturdy cotton canvas drawstring bag, and is neatly presented in a beautiful display box. Each block is made from sustainable Michigan basswood, and features animals, numbers, math symbols, and letters. Generous 1¾" (44mm) size, finely crafted and colorfully painted with non-toxic inks. Ages 2 and up.

item.title: Natural Wood Baseball Bat
item.author: Skylar Challand
item.description: Ronald Acuña Jr.’s signature series maple baseball bat, Pro Hardened for loud, MVP-caliber contact. Louisville Slugger sets itself apart from other bat makers with more than 120 years of experience, outstanding turning models, and access to the best-quality wood on the market.
